posts.t:
The assist was really nice by Koivunen, but it wasnt even his best pass of the night. He had that slick alley-oop backhand pass that was going to spring a Penguin for a breakaway if 71 didnt get called for a trip behind the play

He is learning the pace of the NHL and he already has the hands/mind

I dont understand the people who don't think Koivunen should be in the lineup. 

Last year he 100% didn't deserve it.

This year he has been good. 

Most of the nights he has been in this year there's been a complete dud on the opposite wing. Not tonight
